title: TRIANGLE
claim: A single geometric instrument can host multiple lawful operations without collapsing their semantics: relational addressing, executable distinction rewriting, inverse-query ternary notation, and direct simplex manipulation.

active_modes.GLYPH: 8 addressable loci = 3 vertices + 3 edges + interior + outside/context; independent BLANK / UNKNOWN / INDICATE states; MESSAGE / RETURN / FIELD presets.
active_modes.FORM: one primitive mark attached to any triangle locus; explicit nesting and juxtaposition; deterministic deepest-first CALL/CROSS normalization; trace + marked/unmarked result.
active_modes.POWER: BASE / EXPONENT / RESULT occupy stable corners; one unknown corner selects exponentiation, logarithm or root.
active_modes.BENCH: quick EXPLOIT / EXPLORE / PROVE simplex manipulation; original human-calibration experiment remains frozen separately.

formal_boundary.FORM: Executable minimal primary-arithmetic subset inspired by Laws of Form. Triangle geometry is only the attachment/address container; triangle edges/rotation are not Spencer-Brown rules.
formal_boundary.CALL: two adjacent empty marks in one region reduce to one
formal_boundary.CROSS: a mark containing exactly one empty mark reduces to unmarked space
formal_boundary.rotation: C3 relational permutation in GLYPH/POWER only; not a FORM rewrite

bench.note: Exact pre-unification root preserved before replacement.

verification: triangle.js independent syntax check passed before commit
FORM core extracted as single browser/CI implementation
FORM fixtures cover blank, single mark, CALL, CROSS, CALL→CROSS, triple nesting and normalization idempotence
critical browser smoke includes unified Triangle root
authority_boundary: Local representation/reasoning only. No queue mutation, external send, file move, purchase or physical actuation.
next: Use it as an instrument. Further feature work requires a concrete compression/reasoning failure or a donor mechanism that changes operation, not ornament.
